Mouse drag uses document listeners. Keyboard setTimer schedules one setTimeout at 40ms rather than a repeating interval. scrollTop(value) clamps vertical position and refresh() calls moveBar. Unmount removes window/document listeners and cancels the tracked frame/timer. Local CSS includes scrollpanel.barfocus.ring.width and scrollpanel.barfocus.ring.offset tokens. The SFC has inheritAttrs:false and extends its family base factory, which extends createBaseComponent from @ultimate/vue-core. Both the component and base factory are public at the package root and family subpath; declared dist paths do not establish publication. The local style module exports css/classes from its source file but is not barrel-exported. No component-metadata record or @ultimate/uix-styles entry exists for this family at this revision.
